# keys


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

A web page can only see keys while its own tab is focused and can’t type
into other apps. This server runs on the user’s Mac, so it does both,
with two macOS permissions that are granted to the app that launched it
(Terminal, iTerm, Cursor…), not to the web app itself:

- **Accessibility** lets us post keystrokes into the focused app
  ([`type_key`](https://alix559.github.io/nadayantra/keys.html#type_key))
- **Input Monitoring** lets us see the hold-to-talk key in other apps
  ([`watch`](https://alix559.github.io/nadayantra/keys.html#watch))

### type_key

``` python
def type_key(
    k
):
```

*Type a named special key, or the characters of `k`, into whichever app
has focus. False if macOS won’t allow it.*
